messages:
ana: quick heads-up — after last night's KMS rewrap a subset of customers are seeing SAML decrypt failures and SCIM deprovisioning without audit records. need triage.

leo: can you paste an error sample and which IdPs?

ana: mostly Azure AD + Okta. authproxy excerpt: 2026-02-11T23:42:01Z authproxy ERROR saml decryptAssertion: KMSDecryptFailed: InvalidCiphertextException extid=U:xyz123

sec-oncall: immediate actions: pause the scim deprov queue, open an incident, check KMS key versions and encryption context, and confirm no permissive fallback in code.

ops-bot: queue/scim-deprov paused by @ops at 00:15 UTC

ana: ops reports previous key version v12 still present. remapped alias back to v12 at 00:22 UTC for a temporary rollback — sample assertion now decrypts successfully.

leo: found ~12 deprov runs that lacked audit entries in the 00:00-00:30 window. plan: backfill auditstore from dry-run replays and fix the deprov worker so parse/decrypt failures always emit an explicit AuditEvent (deprov_failed, reason=decrypt_error).

sec-oncall: SEV-2 INC-2026-0521 opened. owners: ops=rollback, eng-identity=shim+tests, security=audit/backfill. notify affected customers and prepare RCA draft.

ana: adding integration test for KMS rewrap+SDK matrix and RBAC rename cache behavior to prevent regressions. will update when backfill completes.
